reason: I'm renovating against an electrician date and need fixtures in hand within a week or two, and 2 to 3 weeks from a store I've never heard of doesn't work. I'd rather order from Amazon Prime or a retailer with stock on hand.
objection: I can't judge the quality from photos, and it's a brand-new store with almost no reviews. A paper pendant at $360 could look flimsy in person, and 2 to 3 weeks of shipping would put me past my deadline.
would_change_my_mind: Fixtures in stock and delivered within about 7 days, with a firm date shown at checkout. Or a cheap sample or swatch I could see before committing, plus a handful of real reviews with customer photos.
